main_text.head: XXXVI. RESPONSUM WILHELMI HASSIÆ LANTGRAVII Nomine datum.
main_text.p: Quæ Serenissimus Princeps ac Dominus Dominus Henricus Rex, Illustrissimo Principi ac Domino no Wilhelmo Landgravio Hassiæ & Domino nostro Clementissimo per Regiæ dignitatis suæ Legatum Dominum Segurium significavit, ea Celsitudini ipsius ex Regiorum mandatorum formulis; tum ex ore ipsius Legati abundè relata sunt.

Ad quæ illustrissima Celsitudo ejus imprimis magnas agit gratias, pro eximia & summa illa in se benevolentiæ & amoris Regiæ dignitatis contestatione, & vicissim Regiæ dignitati fœlicissimum rerum statum & omnia bona faustaque ex animo precatur.

page.notes: Printed text in italic and roman mixed; the old-style long s is rendered as s. The final line is continued at the foot of the page (legatio-nis). The dateline "Nomine datum." is a subtitle. The "L" below the final line is a signature mark or catchword remnant, read with doubt.
